:::{#def-almost-everywhere}
#### Almost everywhere ($\measure$-almost everywhere, $\measure$-a.e.)

Let $(S, \salg, \measure)$ be a [measure space](#def-measure-space).
A statement about the elements of $S$ holds
**$\measure$-almost everywhere**
(written **$\measure$-a.e.**,
or **almost everywhere** when $\measure$ is clear from context)
[@wikipedia_almost_everywhere]
if the set of elements for which it fails
is a [subset](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-subset) of a set of [measure zero](#def-measure-zero).

:::
